worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (person 0) 324,075.00 = 324,075.00. Federal taxable income = 324,075.00 - standard deduction 23,625.00 = 300,450.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form ND-1 line 1b federal taxable income 300,450.00; lines 2-3 additions 0.00, line 4a 0.00; line 4b = 300,450.00. Subtractions lines 5-16: none; line 17 = 0.00. Line 18 North Dakota taxable income = 300,450.00 - 0.00 = 300,450.00. Line 19 = 300,450.00. Line 20 tax: 1.95% x (271,450.00 - 64,950.00) + 2.5% x (300,450.00 - 271,450.00) = 4,026.75 + 725.00 = 4,751.75, to the cent 4,751.75; taxable income is 100,000 or more, so the form itself uses the schedule (PDF p.29). Lines 21-23 credits: line 22 marriage penalty credit: not a joint return, so none. Expected credits 0.00. Line 25 net tax = 4,751.75.
